"""Public scientific workflow used by the task reproduction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path


TASK_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE_DIR = TASK_DIR / "source"
FIXTURE_DIR = TASK_DIR / "fixtures"


def calculate_total_potential_energy() -> float:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_DIR))

    import openmm
    import openmm.app

    coordinates = openmm.app.GromacsGroFile(str(FIXTURE_DIR / "apgr.gro"))
    topology = openmm.app.GromacsTopFile(str(FIXTURE_DIR / "apgr.top"))
    system = topology.createSystem(
        nonbondedMethod=openmm.app.NoCutoff,
        switchDistance=None,
        constraints=None,
    )
    integrator = openmm.VerletIntegrator(1 * openmm.unit.femtosecond)
    context = openmm.Context(
        system,
        integrator,
        openmm.Platform.getPlatformByName("Reference"),
    )
    context.setPositions(coordinates.positions)
    value = context.getState(getEnergy=True).getPotentialEnergy().value_in_unit(
        openmm.unit.kilojoules_per_mole
    )
    return float(value)
